$comment: Documents a known, NOT YET FIXED divergence in 'natural order' sorting across the three places it's implemented: SQL (COLLATE NOCASE, db/playlists.ts NATURAL_ORDER), JS (trackSort.ts compareNatural, uses Intl/localeCompare with numeric:true), and Kotlin (TrackSort.kt compareNatural, uses java.text.Collator at SECONDARY strength, not numeric). Given three same-artist/same-album tracks whose titles differ only in a track number, JS orders them numerically while SQL and Kotlin order them as plain text. See docs/CHANGELOG.md and the plan this came from for the fix (unifying on the numeric-aware order requires either a custom SQLite collation or moving playlistOrderBy's natural-order case to a post-fetch JS/Kotlin sort — not done yet, tracked here so the gap doesn't silently regress further, and so a future fix can verify against these exact titles).
